About Submarine : 
Submarine's animation slate features a multitude of award-winning films and series, which 
are as varied in style as in their target demographic. Submarine Animation prides itself in its 
ability not to be confined to just one look or technique - putting the needs of each individual 
project front-and-center. As such, we work with 2D as well as 3D animation, digital as well as 
traditional crafts, and live-action/animation hybrids. 
About the Production: 
Submarine is slowly starting work on a new 2D animated feature film, developed as a 
co-production with JA Film (Denmark) and Doghouse Films. Our team will take on 2D 
animation and background production this Fall. 
The film is based on the graphic novel trilogy, Dansker, by Halfdan Pisket and tells the story 
of James, a man who flees a traumatic past in Turkey to start a new life in 1970s Denmark. 
Struggling with language barriers and limited opportunities, he finds himself pushed to the 
margins of society and drawn into a harsh criminal underworld, where survival comes at a 
cost. 
Directed by Jonas Poher Rasmussen (Academy Award-nominated for Flee), with animation 
direction by Liane-Cho Han (Little Amelie), the film combines frame-by-frame animation with 
deeply human storytelling.
